<div class="card-body">
'''Dathcha''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ダスチャ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊配備する場合、両者のフォースデッキから２フォースずつ支払う。さもなければ、配備できない。タトゥイーンにのみ配備できるが、他の星系などへ移動することはできる。タトゥイーン以外の位置では、戦闘力＋２。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジャワの冒険家にして商人。クレイト・ドラゴンを挑発して、うまく逃げ出して来た話で有名。銀河を探検するために、タトゥイーンを離れたがっている。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dathcha.

'''Card text:''' To deploy, pay 2 Force from each player's Force deck; otherwise he cannot deploy. He can deploy only on Tatooine but can move to other systems and elsewhere. At locations other than Tatooine, power +2.

'''Lore:''' A Jawa adventurer and trader, famous for the story of taunting a krayt dragon and escaping. He wants to leave Tatooine to explore the galaxy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to each player's Force deck, while the English says each player's Force Pile. The Japanese grants the power bonus at locations other than Tatooine; the English says non-Tatooine sites.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Dathcha]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=100s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 1:40.</ref>
